title: OneCoin buy bid
description: How to buy OneCoins from internal Exchange. Buy now when OneCoin is cheapest.

asr.full_text: Hello! This time we will see how one can purchase one one-coins directly from one-coin internal exchange using funds from cash account or trading account in this case we have funds available in trading account and as we know 40% of your weekly bonuses will be paid out to trading account and you have to use it to some services that Onetcoin is offering for us. So in order to make a Onetcoin buy bid you have to first calculate how many OneCoins you can purchase from the funds that you have available. First we go to exchange, then trading. Currently we can see that the the price is 1.25 So we have to divide our available balance to this price So in this case we will choose to buy 3.784 One-Coins that's pretty much 3784 onecoins. Of course you can choose an amount you like as much as you have enough funds. There is just enough amount to buy. Buy using the beat button. Ask of course if you want to sell some. So number of coins. as you can see the minimum amount is 10 And currently we are buying Actually I made a mistake when I was telling you about the count of 1 coins I will buy 3000 and 271 coins and the amount in total is 3784 Euros approximately and you can choose whether you use your funds from mandatory account at first and then from cash account if available or you can choose directly buy 1 coins through a not cash account we going to use mandatory or now it's called trading account at first and use this option confirm with the transaction password As we know, transaction password is separate from the login password so even if somebody has access to your account without knowing the transaction password, none or any transactions which involves money can not be made. So place order, if you can see that everything is correct as you want, place Order. Okay, there you have a confirmation that OneCoin order was accepted. And within some time, we don't know exactly, it depends of the market. But as we heard, usually the transactions take place in about 24 hours, so maybe later today or next day. You can return to your account and to the trading page and see what has happened. see some history transactions history and of course you will see that your Amount of One-Coins have risen in your testport so what you can do you can make print screen or copy of your testport so I even make it weekly. So you have a overview what will happen in your page. As soon as you have received new OneCoins, you can see the difference. Calculate how many new OneCoins you have purchased and you can always verify transactions on your account, pushing here so you can see when and from what amount transactions have been made from your certain account. Ok! thanks for watching and see you soon in the next video

textual.observation: The source presents purchasing OneCoins through an internal exchange with funds from a cash or trading account, while stating that 40% of weekly bonuses are paid to the trading account and must be used for services offered by OneCoin.

evidence.quote: 40% of your weekly bonuses will be paid out to trading account and you have to use it to some services that Onetcoin is offering for us.
So in order to make a Onetcoin buy bid you have to first calculate how many OneCoins you can purchase from the funds that you have available.
How to buy OneCoins from internal Exchange.

textual.context: The material is presented as an instructional purchase demonstration. Whether the stated bonus is being promoted, merely described, or accurately represented is not established by these records.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated percentage-based bonus is connected to directing funds into a trading account and using those funds for OneCoin services, alongside instructions to purchase OneCoins through the internal exchange.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish that the bonus was actually paid, that the purchase completed, or that any stated value, balance, or outcome was independently verified. The ASR may contain transcription errors.

visual.observation: A branded dashboard displays large bonus and points figures, including "BONUS EARNED THIS WEEK" with €23,217.14 and "TOTAL BONUS EARNED" with €178,945.25, alongside an "UNTIL NEXT BONUS ROUND" countdown and a "DIRECTLY SPONSORED" member count.
visual.context: The visible context is a OneCoin-branded dashboard with account, token, points, member, and market panels; whether the figures are promotional claims, account displays, or a demonstration is unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: The interface presents notable bonus amounts and a time-limited bonus-round display in the same account environment that tracks sponsored members, creating a reward/return claim potentially connected to participation or recruitment activity.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish that the amounts are real, guaranteed, withdrawable, or received by users, and they do not show the terms or any explicit action required to obtain the bonuses.

visual.observation: A "Buy" order dialog shows a token order with a market price, transaction value in EUR, a cash payment method, an expiry date, a transaction-password field, and a prominent "PLACE ORDER" control.
visual.context: This appears within the same branded exchange/trading interface as the dashboard; the supplied frames do not clarify whether it is a live transaction, a demonstration, or ordinary commercial trading.
visual.potential_relevance: A cash-funded token purchase and transaction-password submission are visibly presented within an account interface that also advertises substantial bonus balances, so the relationship between payment activity and the displayed returns may merit conditional review.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show a completed order, payment recipient, password entry or submission outcome, and do not establish any loss, deception, or connection between this order and the displayed bonus amounts.

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker states that a separate transaction password is required for money-related transactions, even when someone has access to the account.

evidence.quote: transaction password is separate from the login password so even if somebody has access to your account without
knowing the transaction password, none or any transactions which involves money can not be made.

visual_context_notes.observation: The sampled screens visibly use OneCoin branding, including a "OneCoin TeamEstonia" presentation and a "ONE COIN MINING EXTRAVAGANZA" event display with an email address and Facebook group URL.

The dashboard visibly includes token balances, market prices, trading controls, member names and sponsorship counts, but no explicit warning, disclaimer, or explanatory terms are legible in the sampled frames.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it urges users to buy OneCoins and demonstrates placing a roughly €3,784 order on OneCoin's internal exchange, while the U.S. Department of Justice has documented OneCoin as a fraudulent cryptocurrency-selling scheme and sentenced a co-founder. The dashboard's weekly-bonus allocation and transaction-password step channel existing balances into purchases of that scheme's purported coin.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 fits purchase of the scheme's purported token using cash or trading-account balances. The video shows the exact buy workflow; DOJ's sentence supplies separate, verifiable project-level fraud context, not proof of this viewer's completed loss.
